description: Issue tracking, project management, and agile workflow tool for software and business teams.
auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 (3LO) for distributed apps, API tokens with basic auth (email + token) for personal scripts/bots, and JWT/scopes for Forge/Connect apps.
credential_notes: Developers can sign up for a free Atlassian account/cloud site and generate API tokens or configure OAuth apps self-serve via the developer console.
api_notes: Comprehensive REST API v3 and GraphQL support covering issues, projects, workflows, boards, sprints, filters, users, and comments.
mcp_notes: Atlassian officially publishes the Atlassian MCP server to bridge Jira and Confluence with external AI solutions.
rationale: Jira provides extensive public REST/GraphQL APIs, self-serve free developer credentials, and an official Atlassian MCP server.

evidence.note: Documents basic auth using API tokens and Atlassian account email for Jira REST APIs.
Outlines REST API v3 authentication options including OAuth 2.0 3LO and ad-hoc personal credentials.
Highlights the official Atlassian MCP server for connecting Jira and Confluence with external AI solutions.
Details rate-limiting structure, quotas, and endpoints for Jira Cloud REST and GraphQL APIs.
